Class TemplatedBuilder<T extends Renderable, SELF extends TemplatedBuilder<T,SELF>>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.views.TemplatedBuilder<T,SELF>
Type Parameters:
T - The class to be built
SELF - The builder itself (so that it can be chained)
Direct Known Subclasses:
TurboFrame.Builder
public abstract class TemplatedBuilder<T extends Renderable, SELF extends TemplatedBuilder<T,SELF>> extends Object
Abstract class to be used by builders which support templates.
Since:
3.4.0
Author:
Sergio del Amo
